_comment: Gear modifiers (LT-05..10). Max one prefix + one suffix per item (LT-07). power 1..3 scales stats linearly; 3 is top strength. Rarity is derived (LT-08): no mods gray, one green, both blue, both at power 3 purple. Found gear rolls these at loot gen; crafted gear is clean and takes LEARNED mods at the Modification Bench (learning destroys the donor item, LT-09). applies gates what an id can roll onto: tool (has tool block), weapon (firearms), gear (has an equip slot). learnable false = junk rolls that the bench refuses to learn. Stat keys: tool_damage/tool_speed/knockback merge into the held tool block (knockback is honoured when M4 combat lands); the rest stack like equip stats; weight_mult scales the item's own weight; yield_chance is a per-power chance to double a scrap roll.
